title: How Often Would You Play the Lottery If It Were Free?
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Promotes his own Beehiiv newsletter funnel; Beehiiv-hosted event

idea.name: Short-form video to newsletter funnel (business ideas content)
idea.one_liner: Post 3-7 face-to-camera short videos a day about business ideas across five platforms, each with a CTA to a newsletter that unlocks an AI-generated SEO business plan, monetised via ads/paid tiers
idea.offer: free daily business-idea videos plus newsletter with business plans
idea.revenue_model: newsletter ads (CPM), paid newsletter, community, other offers

key_quotes.quote: I can expect to get 0.02% of my short form viewers to become newsletter subscribers to me.
Every single one of my videos, I create a business plan for that's keyword optimized that gets published on my website that uses ahrefs to find the right keywords with Claude GPT that I built myself.
Upload manually, separately, to all five platforms.

claims.quote: And it costs me about $6 in labor to have that video edited for me because I don't edit my own videos.
But ever since then, I've been adding 15 to 30,000 organic subscribers per month.

claims.claim: CTA lifts conversion to 1 follower per 300-800 views
claims.quote: but because I have a call to action, a strong call to action, I'm converting one out of every, you know, 300 to 800 views.

claims.claim: One video yielded ~4,000 subscribers worth ~$10 each
claims.quote: So 4,000 newsletter subscribers from one organic video, $6 in cost, 510 minutes of time, and my newsletter subscribers are worth about $10 each.

claims.claim: About 30m views per week across platforms
claims.quote: If you look at these views, about 30 million views per week across platforms.
And then I also just know industry averages like industry standard for a business or finance newsletter is between seven and $15.

acquisition_channels.details: TikTok first to test retention, then Instagram, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat uploaded manually
alternative written medium; add link after post performs

ideas.delivery: Film unscripted on iPhone, editor on Upwork edits within an hour, VA tracks views-per-follow and followers-per-day, assistant generates business plan via custom Claude prompt
ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR consent for newsletter sign-ups; ASA/CAP rules for ad disclosure in newsletter

idea.name: Shipping-container-on-wheels wine/beer tours
idea.one_liner: Toasted Tours runs 4-hour wine or beer sipping tours in a towed shipping container carrying 40 people

key_quotes.quote: And they take people on wine or beer sipping tours all up and down California in a shipping container on wheels.

claims.quote: And they have 40 people on this thing. In case you're not counting, that's $1,800 per hour.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Carrying fare-paying passengers in a towed container likely breaches UK road vehicle/PSV construction and licensing rules; alcohol licensing needed

key_quotes.quote: Go to Facebook Marketplace, search for luxury wedding bathroom trailers. You can buy them for 20 to 30 grand.
